skills.label: Chronology
skills.description: Ordering events, creating timelines, and relating events across time.

skills.label: Spatial thinking
skills.description: Using maps, regions, location, movement, and geography to explain history.

skills.label: Source analysis
skills.description: Using primary and secondary sources, documents, artifacts, and media.

skills.label: Point of view
skills.description: Identifying perspective, context, author position, and competing interpretations.

skills.label: Cause and effect
skills.description: Explaining short-term and long-term causes, consequences, and correlations.

skills.label: Continuity and change
skills.description: Identifying what changed, what persisted, and why.

skills.label: Historical context
skills.description: Placing people and events in time, place, and social conditions.

skills.label: Historical interpretation
skills.description: Recognizing that interpretations can differ and change with new evidence.

skills.label: Evidence and argument
skills.description: Making claims, supporting them with evidence, and evaluating claims.
